args.prompt:
Create a new KFB claymation ink blob sheet, The Portable World. Use the original reference PNGs for the established organic full-body ink monster morphology and modeling. Exactly six whole independent standalone dark charcoal-plum goo figures, three columns and two rows, landscape 1536×1024 true transparent PNG. Every face is sculpted directly into its continuous organic blob. Think six different compact asymmetrical drips, rounded pears, commas and irregular splats, as varied as the original family. Maintain each individual silhouette, with natural soft little lobes at the sides and bottom, sometimes no distinct foot shape. A short round or tapered bottom is welcome. Do not use a standard flared base, wide flat skirt, common lobe row, humanoid chest or cut-off bust. Clothing is just a small removable accessory and props sit close to the side or belly with the lower body visible. Thick sculpted dark lids, white sclera, red iris and black pupil. Soft satin clay, sparse broad hand modeling marks, distinct moods, tiny ink hands. No inherited costume, wing or eyepatch, scenery, floor, shadow, frame or text beyond specified prop marks. Preserve generous transparent separation and exterior margin. Muted garnet, warm sage, ochre and slate. Minimal collars and pins.
Row-major roles:
1. Female-read history teacher. tall arching blob, raised contemplative lids. Key cue: small folded timeline with simple clay icons of a column, gear and lamp.
2. Male-read geography teacher. low broad scalloped blob, searching eyes, small gasp. Key cue: palm-sized relief map with rounded contour rings.
3. Male-read civics teacher. squared rounded blob, serious gaze and pursed lips. Key cue: small ballot box with a blank paper slip.
4. Male-read economics teacher. narrow leaning pear, worried asymmetrical eyes. Key cue: short balance with three chunky coins in one pan.
5. Female-read ethics teacher. wide irregular heart blob, thoughtful side gaze. Key cue: two contrasting colored speech tokens held at equal height.
6. Male-read religious education teacher. upright bean, gentle eyelids and a small warm smile. Key cue: one small lit-looking enclosed amber lantern and a folded page.
Each actor has a distinct complete compact ink contour from crown to lower edge and one clean readable subject or role prop.

material_change: Gentle charcoal/plum satin clay with broader sparse surface marks and smoother liquid, plastic and glass props.
